documents.text: Python is a high-level programming language known for its simplicity and readability.
Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that enables systems to learn from data.
FastAPI is a modern, fast web framework for building APIs with Python 3.7+ based on standard Python type hints.
Docker containers provide isolated environments for running applications consistently across different systems.
Natural language processing (NLP) enables computers to understand, interpret, and generate human language.
React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces, particularly single-page applications.
PostgreSQL is a powerful open-source relational database management system.
Kubernetes orchestrates containerized applications at scale, automating deployment and management.
Deep learning uses neural networks with multiple layers to extract high-level features from raw data.
RESTful APIs use HTTP methods and follow architectural constraints for building web services.
Git is a distributed version control system for tracking changes in source code.
TypeScript adds static typing to JavaScript, improving code quality and developer experience.
Redis is an in-memory data structure store used as a database, cache, and message broker.
Transformers are neural network architectures that use self-attention mechanisms for NLP tasks.
Spring Boot is a Java framework that simplifies building production-ready applications.
Vector databases store and query high-dimensional embeddings for semantic search applications.
CI/CD pipelines automate the process of testing and deploying code changes.
GraphQL is a query language for APIs that allows clients to request specific data.
Microservices architecture structures applications as a collection of loosely coupled services.
Sentiment analysis uses NLP to determine the emotional tone of text data.
